name: LongCat-2.5

lineage.how_derived: the card says it builds on LongCat-2.0 (2026-07-05) and adds visual understanding; trained with long-sequence training, large-scale RL and multi-teacher learning (full-vocabulary KL distillation from specialised agent, reasoning and interaction teachers)

purpose: The card presents a native multimodal MoE for long-horizon agentic tasks: complex codebase development, full-project builds, creative design and 3D tasks, with long-horizon agentic RL and a W4A4 expert quantisation made for domestic AI accelerators (NPU).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE read in both repos (identical): standard MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Meituan, rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense and/or sell.

architecture.kind: multimodal MoE with MLA, an indexer for sparse attention, 128 identity (zero-computation) experts and 3 MTP layers per config.json (model_type pro_v)
architecture.attention: MLA (kv_lora_rank 512) with an indexer (32 index heads, top-k 2048, local window 1024 tokens per config), 64 heads, hidden 8192
architecture.why_this_design: The card describes training and infrastructure motives (long-sequence efficiency, bitwise-identical log-probs between training and inference, KV cache optimisation that nearly doubles decode KV capacity) but gives no reasons for the expert or layer counts. config max_position_embeddings is 524288 while the evaluation notes use up to 1M sequence length.

variants.format: safetensors, W4A4 expert quantisation for INT4 NPU compute (FlatQuant-style transforms)
variants.notes: the card says it keeps accuracy comparable to the unquantised model on the evaluated benchmarks and targets domestic AI accelerators

pc-12gb.notes: smallest official file 1336 GB; no GGUF or other quantised derivative exists (HF API lists 0 derivatives for both repos, 2026-11-19). Even 1 bit per weight of 1.6T parameters is about 200 GB

pc-32gb.notes: 1 bit per weight of 1.6T parameters is about 200 GB, above the about 158 GB (29.6 VRAM + 128 RAM) budget

other: SGLang-FluentLLM NPU branch (card: deployed on NPU platforms)
engine_support.notes: The card documents only NPU deployment with the vendor's SGLang fork.

strengths: Vendor scores close to frontier models on terminal and browsing tasks
weaknesses: 1.6T parameters: no consumer class can hold it
On coding the vendor's own table puts it behind the much smaller DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on DeepSWE and NL2Repo
soft.maturity: Meituan LongCat is a regular releaser (LongCat-2.0 two months earlier, LongCat-Flash-Lite and Lite-Sparse, video and audio models).

tona_fit.reason: 1.6T parameters, 48B active and 1.3 TB even in the W4A4 form with no community quant; out of reach of every class. Its useful smaller relative for our users is longcat-flash-lite-sparse; the coding peer that does fit the large PC class is deepseek-v4.1-flash, which the vendor's own table ranks above LongCat-2.5 on DeepSWE and NL2Repo.
